Intro.0.speaker: Zero
Intro.0.en: Mio? Mio. Are you awake? Your heartbeat says you're awake. Seventy-one departures a minute.
Intro.0.zh_TW: 澪？澪。你醒了嗎？你的心跳說你醒了。每分鐘七十一班發車。

Intro.1.speaker: Mio
Intro.1.en: Good morning to you too, Zero. It's rude to count someone's heartbeat, you know.
Intro.1.zh_TW: 是是是，早安啊，零。隨便數別人的心跳，很沒禮貌喔。

Intro.2.speaker: Zero
Intro.2.en: Is it? Sorry. I'll count something else. ...Wait. What is that smell? It's green, and wet, and a little bit sweet.
Intro.2.zh_TW: 是嗎？對不起。那我去數別的東西。……等一下。這是什麼味道？是綠色的，濕濕的，還有一點點甜。

Intro.3.speaker: Mio
Intro.3.en: Rice paddies after the rain. Hoshikawa smells like this every morning in early summer.
Intro.3.zh_TW: 下過雨的稻田啊。初夏的星川，每天早上都是這個味道。

Intro.4.speaker: Zero
Intro.4.en: Rice paddies after the rain. I'm keeping that one.
Intro.4.zh_TW: 下過雨的稻田。這個我要留著。

Intro.5.speaker: Zero
Intro.5.en: Mio, the freight train is still on the timetable. Three days. Eleven carriages. Passengers listed: zero.
Intro.5.zh_TW: 澪，那班貨運列車還在時刻表上。三天後。十一節車廂。登記的乘客：零。

Intro.7.speaker: Zero
Intro.7.en: Yes. I can hear them through the carriage walls. I told Ren last night, through your terminal. He wants you at the workshop.
Intro.7.zh_TW: 對。隔著車廂的牆壁，我聽得見他們。昨天晚上我透過你的終端機告訴蓮了。他要你去工坊。

Intro.8.speaker: Mio
Intro.8.en: Then let's not keep him waiting.

Briefing.0.speaker: Ren
Briefing.0.en: Mio. Zero passed the word through your terminal last night. I haven't slept since.
Briefing.0.zh_TW: 澪。零昨晚透過你的終端機傳了消息過來。我到現在都沒睡。

Briefing.1.speaker: Ren
Briefing.1.en: A freight train comes through the valley in three days. Zero says its cargo is people, taken out of the cities to somewhere worse.
Briefing.1.zh_TW: 三天後，一班貨運列車會經過山谷。零說，車上載的是人，被從城市裡帶走，要送去更糟的地方。

Briefing.3.speaker: Ren
Briefing.3.en: We can't stop a city train. But the old Hoshikawa line still has a maintenance siding below the viaduct. Bring the manual relay back and we can switch the train onto it.
Briefing.3.zh_TW: 我們攔不下城市的列車。但是舊星川線在高架橋底下，還留著一條維修側線。只要把手動繼電器拿回來，就能把列車引進去。

Briefing.4.speaker: Ren
Briefing.4.en: Three patrol units are camped on the relay road. Clear them and restart the relay. Zero can work the carriage locks from the city side.
Briefing.4.zh_TW: 繼電器古道上駐紮了三台巡邏機。把它們清掉，重新啟動繼電器。零可以從城市那一端操作車廂的鎖。

Briefing.5.speaker: Zero
Briefing.5.en: One, two, three. Three patrols. I counted them yesterday. They have amber eyes and no keepers.
Briefing.5.zh_TW: 一、二、三。三台巡邏機。我昨天數過了。它們有琥珀色的眼睛，沒有主人。

Briefing.6.speaker: Mio
Briefing.6.en: Cross the bridge, follow the lanterns uphill. I know the way.
Briefing.6.zh_TW: 過橋，沿著燈籠往山上走。路我熟。

Briefing.7.speaker: Ren
Briefing.7.en: Don't let them surround you. And Mio, come back in one piece. That terminal on your wrist is the only line we have into the city.
Briefing.7.zh_TW: 別讓它們包圍你。還有，澪，要平安回來。你手腕上那台終端機，是我們通往城市的唯一一條線。

RenReminder.0.speaker: Ren
RenReminder.0.en: Cross the bridge and follow the lanterns uphill. Three patrol units are blocking the manual relay. Do not let them surround you.
RenReminder.0.zh_TW: 過了橋，沿著燈籠往山上走。三台巡邏機擋在手動繼電器前面。別讓它們包圍你。

RenRoadClear.0.speaker: Ren
RenRoadClear.0.en: The road is clear? Then the relay is yours. Follow the lanterns up to the viaduct and wake it up.
RenRoadClear.0.zh_TW: 路清開了？那繼電器就交給你了。沿著燈籠走到高架橋，把它喚醒。

RenRest.0.speaker: Ren
RenRest.0.en: The valley is ready. Zero is still in the city, preparing the other half of our rescue. Rest for a while. You have earned it.
RenRest.0.zh_TW: 山谷準備好了。零還在城市裡，準備我們救援行動的另一半。好好休息一下吧，這是你應得的。

Homecoming.0.speaker: Ren
Homecoming.0.en: I can see the relay's lamp from the workshop roof. Green, for the first time since the line closed.
Homecoming.0.zh_TW: 我在工坊的屋頂上就看得到繼電器的燈。是綠色的，自從這條線停駛以來，這是第一次。

Homecoming.1.speaker: Ren
Homecoming.1.en: When the train comes, we switch it onto the siding, Zero opens the carriages, and we walk those people home.
Homecoming.1.zh_TW: 列車一來，我們就把它引到側線上，零打開車廂，我們再帶那些人回家。

Homecoming.2.speaker: Zero
Homecoming.2.en: Eleven carriages. I'll open every single one. Locks are just very small level crossings.
Homecoming.2.zh_TW: 十一節車廂。我會一節一節全部打開。鎖，不過就是很小很小的平交道。

Homecoming.3.speaker: Ren
Homecoming.3.en: You made a way home, Mio. Tonight, that is enough.
Homecoming.3.zh_TW: 你開出了一條回家的路，澪。今晚，這樣就夠了。

Homecoming.4.en: Night falls over Hoshikawa. One by one, the lanterns are lit.
Homecoming.4.zh_TW: 夜幕降臨星川。燈籠一盞一盞亮了起來。

Homecoming.5.speaker: Zero
Homecoming.5.en: Mio, what are the little lights for? There are twenty-three of them. Twenty-four now.
Homecoming.5.zh_TW: 澪，那些小小的光是做什麼用的？一共有二十三個。現在是二十四個了。

Homecoming.6.speaker: Mio
Homecoming.6.en: Lanterns. Chiyo says every lantern means someone is waiting for you.
Homecoming.6.zh_TW: 燈籠啊。千代奶奶說，每一盞燈籠，都代表有人在等你回家。

Homecoming.8.speaker: Mio
Homecoming.8.en: Everyone here, I suppose. My mother used to light one on our porch every night, even after the cities went dark to us—
Homecoming.8.zh_TW: 這裡的大家吧。我媽媽以前每天晚上，都會在我們家的廊下點一盞，就算城市跟我們斷了線以後也一樣——

Homecoming.9.speaker: Zero
Homecoming.9.en: Mio! The station lights just changed. Something is moving on platform four. I have to go and look at the locks.
Homecoming.9.zh_TW: 澪！車站的燈剛剛變了。四號月台上有東西在動。我得去看看那些鎖。

Homecoming.11.speaker: Zero
Homecoming.11.en: Goodnight, Mio. Thank you for the rice paddies.
Homecoming.11.zh_TW: 晚安，澪。謝謝你給我稻田。

Homecoming.12.en: The link goes quiet. Far beyond the viaduct, the city keeps shining.
Homecoming.12.zh_TW: 連結安靜了下來。高架橋的遠方，城市依然閃耀著。

RelayAsleep.0.speaker: Zero
RelayAsleep.0.en: This is the manual relay! It's asleep. Ren has a plan for it. Go and find Ren first, okay?
RelayAsleep.0.zh_TW: 這是手動繼電器！它睡著了。蓮對它有安排。先去找蓮，好不好？

RelayGuardedNone.0.speaker: Zero
RelayGuardedNone.0.en: The patrols keep polling this relay. I count none still out there. Chase them away first, okay?
RelayGuardedNone.0.zh_TW: 巡邏機一直在呼叫這個繼電器。我數了數，外面一台也不剩。先把它們趕走，好不好？

RelayGuardedOne.0.speaker: Zero
RelayGuardedOne.0.en: The patrols keep polling this relay. I count one still out there. Chase them away first, okay?
RelayGuardedOne.0.zh_TW: 巡邏機一直在呼叫這個繼電器。我數了數，外面還剩一台。先把它趕走，好不好？

RelayGuardedTwo.0.speaker: Zero
RelayGuardedTwo.0.en: The patrols keep polling this relay. I count two still out there. Chase them away first, okay?
RelayGuardedTwo.0.zh_TW: 巡邏機一直在呼叫這個繼電器。我數了數，外面還剩兩台。先把它們趕走，好不好？

RelayGuardedThree.0.speaker: Zero
RelayGuardedThree.0.en: The patrols keep polling this relay. I count three still out there. Chase them away first, okay?
RelayGuardedThree.0.zh_TW: 巡邏機一直在呼叫這個繼電器。我數了數，外面還剩三台。先把它們趕走，好不好？

RelaySteady.0.speaker: Zero
RelaySteady.0.en: The relay is steady. Head back to Ren. ...Mio, one day I want to see this valley with my own eyes.
RelaySteady.0.zh_TW: 繼電器很穩定。回去找蓮吧。……澪，我好想有一天，能用自己的眼睛看看這座山谷。

RelayOnline.0.speaker: Zero
RelayOnline.0.en: Got it! The relay lamp just turned green. That's your signal, Mio. It's so clear.
RelayOnline.0.zh_TW: 接上了！繼電器的燈變綠了。那是給你的進行號誌，澪。看得好清楚。

RelayOnline.1.speaker: Zero
RelayOnline.1.en: Wait. Is that wind? It came down the mountain and it smells sharp and clean. What is it?
RelayOnline.1.zh_TW: 等一下。那是風嗎？它從山上吹下來，聞起來尖尖的、清清的。那是什麼？

RelayOnline.2.speaker: Mio
RelayOnline.2.en: Cedar. The whole pass is full of them.
RelayOnline.2.zh_TW: 杉木。整個山口到處都是。

RelayOnline.3.speaker: Zero
RelayOnline.3.en: Cedar. I'm keeping that one too.

RelayOnline.4.speaker: Zero
RelayOnline.4.en: The maintenance siding is reachable now. I'm still at the city station. You opened the way out, so the locks are mine. Go tell Ren!
RelayOnline.4.zh_TW: 維修側線現在可以通行了。我還在城市的車站。你打開了出路，所以鎖就交給我。快去告訴蓮！

FirstMeeting.Chiyo.0.speaker: Chiyo
FirstMeeting.Chiyo.0.en: The cities still shine at night. But their streets belong to machines now. Here, every lantern means someone is waiting for you.
FirstMeeting.Chiyo.0.zh_TW: 城市到了晚上還是亮的。可是那些街道，現在是屬於機器的了。在這裡啊，每一盞燈籠，都代表有人在等你。

FirstMeeting.Chiyo.1.speaker: Chiyo
FirstMeeting.Chiyo.1.en: ...That terminal on your wrist. May I? Gold casing, a little jade lamp.
FirstMeeting.Chiyo.1.zh_TW: ……你手腕上的那台終端機。可以讓我看看嗎？金色的外殼，一盞小小的翡翠色燈。

FirstMeeting.Chiyo.2.speaker: Mio
FirstMeeting.Chiyo.2.en: I found it in the old signal box on the Hoshikawa line last year. It took me a month to get it working.
FirstMeeting.Chiyo.2.zh_TW: 去年我在星川線的舊號誌所找到的。我花了一個月才讓它動起來。

FirstMeeting.Chiyo.3.speaker: Chiyo
FirstMeeting.Chiyo.3.en: Shio wore one just like it. Your mother never went anywhere without hers.
FirstMeeting.Chiyo.3.zh_TW: 汐也戴過一台一模一樣的。你媽媽不管去哪裡，都帶著她那一台。

FirstMeeting.Chiyo.4.speaker: Mio
FirstMeeting.Chiyo.4.en: Everyone who worked the line had one, didn't they?
FirstMeeting.Chiyo.4.zh_TW: 在鐵道上工作的人，每個人都有一台，對吧？

FirstMeeting.Chiyo.6.en: Chiyo looks past you, toward the city, and says nothing more.
FirstMeeting.Chiyo.6.zh_TW: 千代越過你的肩膀望向城市的方向，沒有再說什麼。

FirstMeeting.Hana.0.speaker: Hana
FirstMeeting.Hana.0.en: KOMA keeps our irrigation running without a network. Old machines are our neighbors. The amber-eyed patrols beyond the bridge are not.
FirstMeeting.Hana.0.zh_TW: KOMA 讓我們的灌溉不用網路也能運轉。老機器是我們的鄰居。橋那邊琥珀色眼睛的巡邏機可就不是了。

FirstMeeting.Hana.1.speaker: KOMA-7
FirstMeeting.Hana.1.en: Correction: this unit is the best neighbor.
FirstMeeting.Hana.1.zh_TW: 更正：本機是最好的鄰居。

FirstMeeting.Hana.2.speaker: Hana
FirstMeeting.Hana.2.en: He's been like this since Grandpa Tetsu registered him. Forty years of the same jokes.
FirstMeeting.Hana.2.zh_TW: 自從鐵爺爺幫他登記以後，他就一直這樣。四十年了，老是同樣的笑話。

FirstMeeting.Hana.3.speaker: KOMA-7
FirstMeeting.Hana.3.en: Registered keeper: Mori Tetsu. Keeper status: napping on the engawa. This unit answers to its keeper, not to the network.
FirstMeeting.Hana.3.zh_TW: 登記主人：森鐵。主人狀態：在緣廊打盹。本機聽從主人，不聽從網路。

FirstMeeting.Hana.4.speaker: Mio
FirstMeeting.Hana.4.en: So that's why the patrols can't give you orders.
FirstMeeting.Hana.4.zh_TW: 所以巡邏機才不能對你下命令。

FirstMeeting.Hana.5.speaker: KOMA-7
FirstMeeting.Hana.5.en: Correct. Patrols have no keepers. Very lonely machines.
FirstMeeting.Hana.5.zh_TW: 正確。巡邏機沒有主人。是非常孤單的機器。

FirstMeeting.KOMA-7.0.speaker: KOMA-7
FirstMeeting.KOMA-7.0.en: Morning diagnostic: tomatoes healthy. Humans worried. Zero is still in the city. This unit is KOMA. Different machine; equally excellent company.
FirstMeeting.KOMA-7.0.zh_TW: 早晨診斷：番茄健康。人類焦慮。零還在城市裡。本機是 KOMA。是不同的機器，同樣是很棒的同伴。

FirstMeeting.KOMA-7.1.speaker: Zero
FirstMeeting.KOMA-7.1.en: Hello, KOMA! What do tomatoes feel like?
FirstMeeting.KOMA-7.1.zh_TW: 你好，KOMA！番茄摸起來是什麼感覺？

FirstMeeting.KOMA-7.2.speaker: KOMA-7
FirstMeeting.KOMA-7.2.en: Round. Warm in the afternoon. Unit Zero, you ask many questions for a railway system.
FirstMeeting.KOMA-7.2.zh_TW: 圓的。下午是溫的。零號機，以鐵路系統來說，你問的問題真多。

FirstMeeting.KOMA-7.3.speaker: Zero
FirstMeeting.KOMA-7.3.en: I only ever had trains. Mio has everything else.
FirstMeeting.KOMA-7.3.zh_TW: 我以前只有火車。其他的一切，都在澪那裡。

FirstMeeting.Aki.0.speaker: Aki
FirstMeeting.Aki.0.en: Hold your guard against a strike, or tap it just before impact to deflect. A broken posture leaves you exposed. Let me patch you up.
FirstMeeting.Aki.0.zh_TW: 承受攻擊時按住防禦，或是在命中前一瞬間輕點，就能彈反。架勢一旦崩潰，你就會露出破綻。來，我幫你處理一下。

FirstMeeting.Aki.1.speaker: Aki
FirstMeeting.Aki.1.en: And if there really are people on that train, they'll need beds. I'm clearing out the clinic tonight.
FirstMeeting.Aki.1.zh_TW: 還有，如果那列火車上真的有人，他們會需要床鋪。今晚我會把診所騰出來。

FirstMeeting.Sora.0.speaker: Sora
FirstMeeting.Sora.0.en: I saw three sentries on the old relay road. Watch for the red diamond: that sweeping attack cannot be blocked. Dodge through it or jump away.
FirstMeeting.Sora.0.zh_TW: 我在舊繼電器古道上看到三個哨兵。注意紅色菱形：那種橫掃攻擊擋不住。要穿過去，或是跳開。

FirstMeeting.Sora.1.speaker: Zero
FirstMeeting.Sora.1.en: A red diamond. Like a stop signal! Stop signals keep everyone safe.
FirstMeeting.Sora.1.zh_TW: 紅色菱形。就像停止號誌！停止號誌會保護大家的安全。

Komorebi.Nao.0.speaker: Nao
Komorebi.Nao.0.en: Welcome to Komorebi, Mio. Travelers from Hoshikawa take the cedar bridge below the orchards. There is always a place by our stove when the mountain mist rolls in.
Komorebi.Nao.0.zh_TW: 歡迎來到木漏日，澪。從星川來的旅人，都是走果園下方的杉木橋過來的。山霧飄下來的時候，我們的火爐邊永遠有個位子。

Komorebi.Emi.0.speaker: Emi
Komorebi.Emi.0.en: That pass is a long walk. Sit for a moment: I can treat your wounds and refill your remedies. The clinic keeps its doors open for both villages.
Komorebi.Emi.0.zh_TW: 那個山口要走很遠吧。坐下來歇一會兒：我可以處理你的傷口，也能補充你的藥草。診所的大門，對兩個村子都是敞開的。

Komorebi.Toma.0.speaker: Toma
Komorebi.Toma.0.en: These trees fed our grandparents before the city grid reached the valley. Now they feed our neighbors again. Follow the south lanterns to the bridge if you are returning to Hoshikawa.
Komorebi.Toma.0.zh_TW: 在城市電網還沒送進山谷之前，這些樹就養活了我們的祖父母。現在，它們又在養活我們的鄰居。如果你要回星川，就沿著南邊的燈籠走到橋邊。

Komorebi.Yui.0.speaker: Yui
Komorebi.Yui.0.en: I carry letters between our villages. The rain shelter is south of the cedar bridge; the overlook is on its north bank. Ren will be waiting back in Hoshikawa if your relay work is finished.
Komorebi.Yui.0.zh_TW: 我在兩個村子之間送信。避雨小屋在杉木橋的南邊；瞭望台在橋的北岸。如果你的繼電器工作做完了，蓮應該正在星川等你。
